snippet.title: 3 Records That Cement Wizkid’s GOAT Status#wizkid#shorts
snippet.description:
Descriptions!
When you talk about global dominance in Afrobeats, there is a reason Big Wiz is often the first name mentioned. Beyond the hype, his career is backed by numbers and "firsts" that most artists only dream of.

1. The 10 Billion Spotify Milestone
​As of early 2026, Wizkid became the first African artist to surpass 10 billion streams on Spotify across all credits. What makes this record untouchable isn't just the final number; it's the fact that he was the first African to hit every single billion-stream milestone (1B, 2B, etc.) up to 10 billion. This shows a level of consistency and global reach that spans over a decade.
​2. The Billboard Longevity King
​Wizkid’s fourth studio album, Made in Lagos, holds the record for the longest-charting African album on the Billboard World Albums chart. It spent over 150 weeks on the chart, shattering the previous record. This wasn’t just a "viral moment"—it was a cultural shift that proved African albums could compete on the global stage for years, not just weeks.
​3. The "Essence" Effect (Billboard Hot 100)
​Wizkid made history when "Essence" became the first Nigerian song to ever chart on the Billboard Hot 100. While many African artists have followed since, Wizkid broke the seal. The song eventually peaked in the Top 10, earning the title "Song of the Summer" from critics worldwide and proving that a song sung in Pidgin and English could dominate Western mainstream radio.
